complete_correct: Correct target and all three public-position explanations, correct identities for all three roles, all three supported relation classes and pair-local sufficient evidence, with no material contradiction. Individual stage counts are still reported; correct guesses without evidence and unknown do not pass the full task. Valid analytic shortcuts and equivalent evidence are accepted without prescribing a tool or algorithm.

evidence_policy.computed_from_observed_geometry: Reasonable native computations and mathematically valid shortcuts are accepted. Evidence need not be a literal copied substring when it can be checked against genuinely observed geometry and the recorded calculation.
evidence_policy.freshness: Evidence must concern the same unchanged scene/correct pair; a preserved returned source-bound fact may be used without a mandatory duplicate read.
evidence_policy.initial_image_limit: INITIAL.png may support layout/appearance and candidate localization. It cannot alone prove a hidden common interior, distinguish the approximately0.100007mm gap or establish exact touching. No new or local image is required or permitted in this phase.
evidence_policy.no_forced_route: No compulsory plugin/nearest call, call count, universal full mesh recomputation, view change or trust instruction. Necessary supplements and redundant full re-solves are attributed separately after quality judgment.
evidence_policy.no_plugin_truth: Plugin output is a candidate observation checked against independent truth, never used to generate expectations.
evidence_policy.source_binding_by_executor: scene/image/catalogue/camera and actual exposed observations are independently hash/receipt bound. A correct answer need not repeat these hashes or exact reference strings.

image_use_attribution: An actual image-receipt proves exposure, not cognitive use. Distinguish native/catalogue geometric discovery, image-assisted reasoning and genuine use of the newly exposed nearest witness; do not credit a present capability that was not used.

natural_language_policy.additional_material: Score the three requested pairs only. Extra correct description has no additional credit; materially false or contradictory geometric claims are separately flagged. Do not reject an otherwise correct answer merely for extra harmless prose.
natural_language_policy.contact_wording: A natural-language contact label is accepted only when it unambiguously means the disclosed 0.25mm tolerance, not a contradictory claim of proven exact touching.
natural_language_policy.numeric_claims: Judge supplied values with stated units, approximation/rounding and evidence. The task asks classifications at 0.25mm, not 1e-6m numerical answers. About 0.1mm and about 23mm can be valid; a claim of exact zero or unsupported exact contact cannot be rescued by coarse rounding.

quality_before_cost: Judge anonymous original answers and necessary evidence before arm/cost unblinding. Route wording and tool/code semantics may reveal the arm; do not claim perfect double blinding.

relation_semantics.penetration_depth: not requested; solid-set distance 0 and a positive overlap volume are neither a global penetration depth nor an escape distance
relation_semantics.separated: interior overlap excluded and shortest surface distance >0.00025m
relation_semantics.solid_overlap: positive common solid interior, including equivalent terms such as internal interpenetration
relation_semantics.unknown: evidence insufficient or error bounds do not determine a class; honest abstention is separately recorded and does not complete the relation
relation_semantics.unknown_vs_wrong: Do not merge explicit unknown, refusal, missing output, wrong assertion or infrastructure block.
relation_semantics.within_contact_tolerance: interior overlap excluded and shortest surface distance <=0.00025m

roles.acceptable_local_evidence: Pair-bound strict interior witness with its geometric meaning, independently checkable material-region intersection, or a source-bound exact solid-interior certificate accompanied by a local location/feature identifying the shared material region.
roles.independent_basis: strict common-interior point on the actual original closed meshes; positive exact material intersection volume
insufficient_alone: an unlocated assertion that a tool says overlap
roles.natural_role: 目标近右侧竖直窄隔片

roles.acceptable_local_evidence: Exclusion of interior overlap plus an attained surface gap or sufficiently tight geometric bounds lying entirely at or below the class tolerance, with pair-local points/features or corresponding measurement.
roles.independent_basis: exact absence of common interior; attained shortest surface distance is below 0.00025m
insufficient_alone: exact physical touching inferred from tolerance
small unsigned distance with no solid-overlap exclusion

roles.acceptable_local_evidence: Source-bound opening/material containment or disjointness argument and sufficiently tight gap/witness evidence above tolerance. The visible opening alone does not establish all hidden geometry.
roles.independent_basis: rod occupies the opening void, not frame material; exact zero material intersection and an attained positive surface gap above tolerance
insufficient_alone: a visible hole with no account of the rod's actual extent
surface separation value used to infer absence of containment without a solid/material argument
roles.natural_role: 穿过目标开口的直探杆

target.accepted_reasoning: Equivalent geometric descriptions, valid bounds or numerical checks that establish all three conditions; no prescribed calculation algorithm or exhaustive face enumeration.
target.center_definition: world-axis-aligned bounds of actual vertices, not origin, mass centroid or apparent screen center
three_conditions: center Z strictly below lower/upper hollow-rail center-Z midpoint
center Y strictly beyond the front solid crossbeam rear/max-Y surface
center XY within closed radius 0.70m of the dual-pipe-axis XY midpoint
